build_infer_auto_device_map: build a device map for a model to distribute layers across GPUs, CPU, and disk based on available memory
compute_module_sizes: compute the size in bytes of each submodule and leaf module of a PyTorch model
get_balanced_memory: compute a balanced max_memory dictionary to distribute model weights evenly across available GPUs
accelerate_dispatch: dispatch a model across multiple devices using accelerate's dispatch_model with offload support
check_and_set_device_map: validate and normalize a device_map argument from int, string, or device object into a dictionary
